defect: keep-bit counting loop bound is one past the last bit
rationale: The loop runs to KEEP_WIDTH inclusive and selects tkeep_i[i], so the last iteration reads bit KEEP_WIDTH of a KEEP_WIDTH-bit vector.

mutation.description: Replaced the thermometer compare by a bit select inside the inclusive loop.

author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the byte counting of the keep mask to a frame length counter with a parameterised keep width.

labels.note: The final loop iteration indexes one bit beyond tkeep_i.
